Cell.Text: Oh, wow, never thought someone else will reach this place. | I bet yu are some adventurer? What's your name?

Oh, my story pretty complicated. | I was an adventurer too, and went into this dwemer ruins. | I found falmers here, and was thinking to not to explore this place further, because fighting them would have been the last mistake in my life... | But somehow these particula ones appeared to be friendly by some reason. | And I decided to stay here.

Node.Caption: lope_FalmersGirl_hellpA1: I'm . What are you doing here?

Cell.Text: Well, I said my story is complicated, right?

Node.Caption: lope_FalmersGirl_hellpA2: Just like that? Stay here with falmers?

Cell.Text: Well... I found them... cute. | I know, it sounds ridicoulus to someone from above, but... | It's just something I never experienced in my life, and these falmers are friendly. | I just couldn't resist the opportunity to stay here. | I like weird stuff, and these elves, they just... intersting.

Node.Caption: lope_FalmersGirl_hellpA3: Yeah, but still, living with farmers? You probably have some serious reason to do so.

Cell.Text: I can't guarantee everybody will be friendly for you deeper in the ruins. | Some falmers of chaures in depths of this city could be not as friendly. | Just be carefull if you will deside go further, okay? | Oh, and of course, dwarven spiders and spheres are aggressive anyway, so be carefull around them too.

Node.Caption: lope_FalmersGirl_hellpA4: Everyone in this dwerver ruins are friendly?

Cell.Text: Mine got weary, and these guys helped me to make chitin armor.

Cell.Text: Yeah, chitin is pretty light, and it's enough to cover my delicates.
Theys are not speaking, so it was pretty hard to start doing that. | But they are people too, so it's possible.
